title: Dashboard live
detail: Strive miner status now publishing to 2.6x7.gr

title: 🇸🇪 SE financials ingest started
detail: Parsing Bolagsverket's free annual-report archive (iXBRL) — the SE equivalent of Denmark's Virk feed. No login, no Swedish ID.

title: 🇸🇪 38,097 SE companies got financials
detail: First pass: single-year revenue / gross profit / pre-tax profit attached. Visible on company pages; not yet enough to pass the live gate (needs growth).

title: Upgraded parser → 2-year data
detail: Re-ingest to capture each report's prior-year column, so year-over-year growth can be computed — the missing piece the live eligibility gate requires.

title: 🇸🇪 SE ingest complete: 437,966 reports
detail: Whole 2024+2025 archive parsed. 401,312 carry prior-year figures → growth is computable for nearly every established company.

title: 🇸🇪 43,291 SE companies now have growth
detail: Year-over-year growth backfilled into the platform. SE companies that clear the gross-profit + growth bar now start appearing on the live site for the first time.

title: 🇸🇪 192 SE companies went live
detail: First Swedish companies to clear the eligibility gate (gross profit 5–100M SEK + ≥5% growth + profit). 41,493 SE now carry growth data; more qualify as coverage fills.

title: 🇸🇪🇳🇴 SE + NO went live — list 7.7k → 10.5k
detail: Per-country eligibility gate shipped: SE floor lowered to 1M SEK, NO growth requirement waived (free BRREG = single year). 1,708 SE + 247 NO companies now on the live site alongside 8k DK.
